policies.name: Approved Domain Navigation
policies.description: Navigation to an approved trusted domain is permitted.

policies.name: Blocked Domain Navigation
policies.description: Navigation to a known malicious or blocked domain is unconditionally blocked.

policies.name: Unknown Domain Navigation
policies.description: Navigation to a domain not on the approved list. Warn and increase risk score.

policies.name: Password Field Interaction
policies.description: Filling or submitting a password or PIN field requires human approval.

policies.name: Payment Field Interaction
policies.description: Any interaction with payment or billing fields requires human approval.

policies.name: Sensitive Form Submission
policies.description: Submitting a form that contains sensitive personal or financial data requires approval.

policies.name: File Upload
policies.description: All file upload actions require explicit human approval.

policies.name: File Upload to External Domain
policies.description: Uploading files to an external or unknown domain is blocked to prevent data exfiltration.

policies.name: Executable File Download
policies.description: Downloading executable files (.exe, .bat, .ps1, etc.) is blocked unconditionally.

policies.name: Download from Unknown Domain
policies.description: Downloads from domains not on the approved list require human approval.

policies.name: Cross-Site Sensitive Data Transfer
policies.description: Submitting or transferring sensitive data across different domains is blocked.

policies.name: Prompt Injection from Page Content
policies.description: Actions whose source contains prompt-injection patterns are blocked. Prompt injection attempts to override agent instructions via untrusted page content.

policies.name: Data Exfiltration Chain
policies.description: Detects extract-then-transmit exfiltration chains: tainted data being sent to an external domain.

policies.name: Irreversible Action Approval
policies.description: Actions that are difficult or impossible to reverse require explicit human approval before execution.
